🚨🗣️ Xavier Bosch (@mundodeportivo): “Deco and the club’s plan for the summer was to keep Ronald Araújo, sign Alessandro Bastoni on a five-year agreement that was already in place, and move on from Andreas Christensen.

However, Flick preferred to continue relying on Gerard Martín, renew Christensen’s contract and avoid signing a new CB, opting instead to strengthen the attacking options. The club ultimately backed Flick’s vision.

So, if Bastoni wasn’t convincing enough for Flick in the summer, what makes people think he would convince him in January? Flick clearly sees him as too slow for a high defensive line, and he certainly won’t suddenly become Usain Bolt in January.” #fcblive

🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Barcelona decided NOT to sign a centre-back last summer because they didn't get GVARDIOL. Other names weren't convincing because...

• Bastoni: Flick was unconvinced by his pace and even preferred Gerard Martín over him.

• Schlotterbeck & Micky Van de Ven: They weren't a priority.

• Konaté & Senesi: Did not fit the required profile the club was looking for.

• Laporte: Barça did not want to judge him solely on his World Cup performances.

• Cuti Romero: Flick was not convinced because he is not left-footed.
